title: The Museum Guide
narration: The museum audio guide described my murder before it happened. It directed me away from a running guard and into an empty display case. The guard instead told me to check my handbag, where I found a stolen pendant. My boyfriend had planted it and programmed the guide to move me away from security while he escaped. Police caught him waiting in our car. Every explanation I tried made the details worse, because each clue had been placed where I alone would find it. I wanted to leave immediately, but doing that would mean abandoning the only proof that any of this had happened. The silence felt deliberate, as though someone nearby was waiting for me to understand the trap before moving again. The guide announced that I survived but he did not, seconds before the car exploded.
